from.place: proof: over a valuation ring, generic triviality implies triviality (Tag 0EX8)

title: Generic-fibre triviality over a valuation ring
statement: Let A be a valuation ring with fraction field K, let X_A\to Spec(A) be flat, proper, and of finite presentation with integral closed fibre, and let L be an invertible module on X_A [def-sc-invertible-module]. If H^0(X_K,O_{X_K})=K and the restriction L|_{X_K} is trivial, then L is trivial on X_A. Flat, proper, finite-presentation, and fibre notions are from [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties].
